title: Keep content inside the screen on phones (select popups, bell, member approvals, contact email, logo preview)
request: please fix everything that comes up, dont just wait until you are done with a task to ask me if you can fix (the 320px audit found content running past the screen or its box on phones)

criteria.text: Select popups (season filters on Live Corrections, Weekly Content, Participation): the popup is never wider than the screen and long option names wrap; before: 376.9px wide on a 320px phone with 4 options cut off
criteria.evidence: Probe at 320x640, 360x740, 390x844: popup was 376.9px wide with 4, 1 and 0 options cut by the screen edge; now 300, 340 and 370px wide with 0 cut (long names wrap). At 1280 and 768px the popup is identical (376.9 x 262). Picture: .factory/evidence/T-261106-keep-content-inside-the-/sheetP1.png. Test pin fails on the old code. Also probed Weekly Content and Participation season selects at 320, 360, 390px (after only): popup 300, 340 and 355.8px wide, 10px inside the screen, 0 of 6 options cut at all three (before, from the audit: 4 options cut at 320px on these pages). Saved: after-seasons/numbers.txt.

criteria.text: Batch Matches team dropdown: the popup stays inside the screen at 320, 360 and 390px; before: 111px, 71px and 41px past the right edge
criteria.evidence: Batch Matches team dropdown: popup 421px wide, 111, 71 and 41px past the right edge (3, 3, 2 options cut) at 320, 360, 390px -> ends 10px inside the screen at all three, 0 options cut; identical at 1280 and 768px. Picture: .factory/evidence/T-261106-keep-content-inside-the-/sheetP1.png.

criteria.text: Contact Inbox (/admin/contact-inbox): a long email address, name or team wraps inside its card; before: the email was 17.5px past the screen at 320px
criteria.evidence: 49-character email: 17.5px past the screen at 320px (58.5px past the card) -> wraps to 2 lines, 54.8px inside the screen and 13.8px inside the card at 320, 360 and 390px. Name and team lines wrap too (test pin fails on the old code). Identical at 1280 and 768px.

criteria.text: Header bell popover: a long notification title wraps inside the list, all notifications can be reached by scrolling, and the popover fits the screen height and scrolls when taller; before: the list was 756px wide in a 270px box (text cut) and the popover was 648.5px tall on a 640px screen with no scroll
criteria.evidence: Bell: long title list was 756px wide in a 270px box (text cut) -> list as wide as its box (270, 310, 326px), text wraps (picture .factory/evidence/T-261106-keep-content-inside-the-/sheetP2.png). Popover was 648.5px tall on a 640px screen (72.5px past the bottom, not scrollable) -> ends at the screen bottom and scrolls inside at 320x640 and 360x740, fits at 390x844. With 20 notifications the list was 2282px tall in a 400px box and could not scroll (nothing below the first 400px reachable); now it scrolls to the end (3362 of 3762 at 320px). No horizontal scrollbar. Two tests fail on the old code.

criteria.text: Member Approvals (/admin/teams): the request card is no wider than the screen and its Approve and Reject buttons are on screen; before: the card was 390px wide on every phone width (cut 86px at 320px)
criteria.evidence: Member Approvals card was 389.9px wide on every phone (16..406 on a 320px screen, cut off) -> 288, 328, 358px = screen width minus 32 at 320, 360, 390px (picture .factory/evidence/T-261106-keep-content-inside-the-/sheetM.png). 1280px identical. At 768px with the very long fake name the row now wraps (card 178 -> 222px tall), still fully visible. Second round (review): a long name with no spaces (29-character username, 37-character team name) ran 15.6px past a 320px screen because the card list was a grid column sized by its widest content; now grid-cols-1 plus min-w-0 on the flex parts: row exactly the card width (238, 278, 308px), 41px inside the screen at all three. Test pin fails on the old code. Files: after-long/ and before-long/ numbers in the probe output. Saved: before-long/numbers.txt and after-long/numbers.txt. The letter avatar stays 32x32 with the long names (shrink-0, added after the re-review).

criteria.text: Update Logos card: the whole team logo or initials circle shows inside the 80px preview box; before: a 144px logo in an 80px box, 32px cropped on every side, at every width
criteria.evidence: Update Logos preview: a 144px logo in the 80px box, 32px cropped on every side at every width -> 80x80, 0 cropped at 320, 360, 390, 768 and 1280px. The 144px size (lg) is kept for the other screens that use it. Tests fail on the old code.

criteria.text: Nothing else moves: same visible text on every touched screen, no new console errors, no sideways page scroll, existing tests pass, and each new test fails on the old code
criteria.evidence: Desktop and tablet (1280, 768) compared before and after for select, contact, bell, members, preview, batch and My Team: identical except the named fixes (bell title wraps so the popover is 80px taller; logo preview 80px instead of a cropped 144px; Member Approvals with a very long name wraps its row at 768px). Console errors unchanged within noise (the same 2-3 fake-network errors on every page); no sideways page scroll anywhere. 10 new or changed tests fail on the old code. Six checks pass at e3a8bdd: unit 840 files / 7779 passed (7779).

criteria.text: My Team page, team edit row (logo, name, 36-character team ID): no overflow at phone widths and the ID is not squeezed; before: row content 260px in a 230px row at 320px, ID text 4.7px past the card and 5 lines at 320 and 360px
criteria.evidence: My Team page at 320, 360, 390px: row content 260 vs row 230 at 320px (ID 4.7px past the card, 5 lines at 320 and 360px) -> no overflow (scroll width = row width: 230, 270, 300px), ID 2 lines at 320 and 360px; 390px unchanged (3 lines); 768 and 1280px: ID on 1 line as before. Test pin fails on the old code. Not changed: the Message Board feed, probed with a long unbroken link: it already wraps inside the feed (no overflow). Numbers saved: before-myteam/numbers.txt, after-myteam/numbers.txt. Close-ups before | after at 320 and 360px: sheetT.png (before: the Team ID runs to the card edge beside the 144px logo; after: logo above, name and ID below, inside the card). Message Board feed probe numbers: before-feed-numbers.txt (no overflow, no change made).

reviews.summary: Plan review APPROVE (no blocking finding). Lines VERIFIED; Radix select/popover vars exist; selectors and trailing-! syntax compile. Taken: select class inside the popper block; probe the bell Viewport max-height (20 items) and a horizontal scrollbar; min-w-0 break-words on the member name; lg stays (other users); contact name/team wrap; TeamEditSection row; MessageFeed probe.

Independent code review APPROVE at e3a8bdd after two rounds. Round 1: no blocking defect, suggestions all taken (unbroken member names via grid-cols-1 + min-w-0, other season selects probed, evidence files saved, vertical-only gap). Round 2: APPROVE; cosmetic suggestion (shrink-0 on the letter avatar) implemented; evidence gaps closed. Verified: Tailwind syntax and Radix vars, select has no caller className conflicts, TeamLogo size union has no other consumer, no protected path, each new test fails on the old code.

Independent review (factory-reviewer, read-only) re-checked this task at the final commit 9a5d54e. After the earlier approval at e3a8bdd only ContactInboxSection (email link gained hit-area-44; wrap classes and test kept) and select.tsx (trigger h-11, touch rows; the max-width class and test kept) changed. The reviewer read the CSS for hit-area-44 and expected no sideways overflow; I then re-measured the 49-character email at 320, 360 and 390px: it ends 13.8, 15.9 and 15.4px inside its card, 0 sideways scroll. Docs for this task (bell, Member Approvals, contact inbox, logo preview, My Team) were checked against the code; findings fixed in 1bec9e3 and 9a5d54e.

notes.text: Code review round 1: APPROVE with suggestions, all taken (long unbroken member names fixed with grid-cols-1 + min-w-0; Weekly Content/Participation selects probed; evidence for criterion 8 saved; vertical-only gap). Not changed on purpose: nested scroll in the bell panel (popover 574px inside a 320x640 screen holding a 400px list) and calendar day cells (36px wide so seven fit a 320px phone; 44px tall). At 375px the My Team row now wraps under the logo (switch point is about 378px); this is consistent with 320 and 360.
